item.content:encoded:
AI 基础设施日报 2026-11-07

生成时间: 2026-11-07 02:20 UTC | 覆盖项目: 6 个

  • vLLM
  • SGLang
  • llama.cpp
  • Ollama
  • LiteLLM
  • Unsloth

横向对比

⚠️ 横向对比生成失败。

各项目详细报告

vLLM — vllm-project/vllm

vLLM Digest — 2026-11-07

1. Today's Highlights

No new vLLM releases landed in the last 24 hours; activity is concentrated in open PRs and long-running design threads. The Rust frontend parity roadmap continues to attract the most discussion (#44280), while the Q4 2026 roadmap was published (#61024). Performance work spans ROCm DSpark/MLA paths, FP8 prefill, MoE DP padding, and multimodal encoder CUDA graphs; stability attention remains on disaggregated KV transfer and hybrid-model correctness.

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • Kimi-K3 FP8 MLA on ROCm gfx1250 — open PR adds AITER FP8 MHA plus MLA prefill/decode paths, scoped to Kimi-K3 with FP8 KV cache; other models/arches retain existing paths. PR #66208
  • DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 DSpark on ROCm — PR stacks context WKV projections, replacing three per-layer GEMMs with one combined GEMM. PR #66212
  • GPT-OSS MXFP4 on ROCm AITER fused MoE — fix forwards quant_config.gemm1_clamp_limit (GPT-OSS uses 7.0) into AITER, which previously only read moe_config.swiglu_limit. PR #66210
  • Nemotron 3.5 ASR streaming — feature request for nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, a 600M multilingual streaming ASR model. Issue #47455
  • GLM-5.3 optimization — follow-up to prior GLM work; same glm_moe_dsa architecture as GLM-5.2, with remaining CUDA and kernel opportunities tracked. Issue #57406
  • Rust frontend parity — experimental Rust API-server replacement via VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1; roadmap tracks missing features relative to the Python frontend. Issue #44280
  • ReplaySSM for SSM/linear-attention decode — RFC proposes caching SSM inputs rather than state for Mamba2 and Gated DeltaNet, targeting decode memory bandwidth. Issue #47572
  • Large-page KV cache allocator — RFC for one KV cache group per spec, motivated by hybrid models requiring different page sizes. Issue #64401
  • Engine-neutral sharded weight transfer — “load plan” RFC for NCCL/M2N and sharded RDMA/NIXL engines to know which tensor slices each rank needs and where they land. Issue #64418
  • MiMo-V2 omni video timestamps — bugfix labels video grids with sampled frames’ actual media time instead of fixed 1-second spacing. PR #66201

4. Performance & Optimization

  • FP8 prefill page expansion on SM120 — bounded conversion of referenced FP8 KV pages into BF16 scratch; recorded paired cold-prefill tests showed up to 10.1% input-token throughput improvement, while retaining FP8 storage. PR #64942
  • MoE DP padding skip — avoids processing padded rows in FlashInfer TRT-LLM monolithic MoE kernels under data parallelism on Blackwell block-FP8/MXFP8 checkpoints. PR #65972
  • Multimodal encoder CUDA graphs — moves from greedy splitting into multiple padded replays toward one replay per batch, with a finer grid up to the max token budget. PR #65227
  • DSpark windowed draft context — computes context K/V precompute and main_proj only for trailing rows when all KV groups are sliding-window; targets long-context drafting (16K-token example cited). PR #60320
  • DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MegaMoE locality placement — opt-in placement of expert weights in the GPU memory locality domain of the SMs that read them via DeepGEMM’s locality allocator. PR #64835
  • Direct weight reload rollout — models must opt in; known-silent reload paths are refused, preparing VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=direct to become default. PR #66002
  • Speculative-decoding oracle benchmark — reference-replay benchmark compares real draft methods (EAGLE, n-gram, etc.) against saved target-model output on the same prompts. PR #62258
  • Rust preprocessing benchmark — community comparison of Rust vs. PyTorch preprocessing performance. Issue #47601
  • Regression watch: MoE decode reported ~15% slower on SM12x since DeepGEMM contiguous-layout alignment changed from 64 to 128. Issue #58624
  • P/D descriptor overhead: GLM-5.3 P/D on GB200 with NIXL sees 91k–120k KV descriptors per TP-rank transfer, making descriptor submission, not fabric bandwidth, the bottleneck. Issue #55434

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. Silent KV corruption in NixlConnector P/D — producer releases KV blocks on lease expiry while a remote READ is still in flight; decode can consume overwritten KV with no error. Issue #61229
  2. Illegal memory access / gibberish on Qwen3.8-27B GDN hybrid with PP=3 — Xid 31 with prefix caching, incorrect output without it; regression since v0.28.0 across v0.31.0/v0.32.0 and both model runners. Issue #63505
  3. TP worker hang → EngineDeadError — RPC sample_tokens timeout with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, TP=8, MTP speculative decoding; high community attention (8 👍). Issue #41530
  4. FP4 TP splits cutting compressed-tensors scale groups — NVFP4/MXFP4 row-parallel and MoE w2 layers could silently multiply FP4 codes by other groups’ scales. Fix PR refuses invalid splits. PR #66213
  5. DeepSeek DSv4.1 v0.32.0 block-size failure — neither 64 nor 128 works on the release tag; issue closed with fix tracked in #60762. Issue #59203
  6. Marlin MoE batch invariance — output depends on equivalent within-expert token ordering, affecting deterministic/batch-invariant serving. Issue #52525
  7. Hybrid models with ≥3 attention groups + EAGLE/MTP + prefix caching untested — block-drop behavior not validated for DeepSeek-V4-Flash/DSpark-class models. Issue #51771
  8. Qwen3.5 hybrid GDN + dflash speculative decoding + PP — missing supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp opt-in blocks the combination. Issue #60765
  9. Responses API drops tool-call items — previous_response_id loses function_call/function_call_output from stored context. Issue #43244
  10. Responses API HTTP 500 on empty/refusal content — replaying a prior assistant turn with empty or refusal content crashes _construct_message_from_response_item; fix PR open. Issue #49130
  11. Packed weight-transfer misalignment — odd-sized packed NCCL/IPC entries shift later entries; fix copies misaligned slices on unpack. PR #65487
  12. Dequant identity dtype mismatch — generic fallback builds identity in out_dtype but feeds it as an activation; fix builds it in the layer’s activation dtype. PR #66209
  13. CI/eval fixes — ROCm test_block_fp8.py skip condition corrected (PR #66205); B200 nightly gsm8k eval failures fixed via config-only changes for ReplaySSM, Kimi-K3 DSpark, and DeepEP LL (PR #66207).

Also closed in this window: Qwen1.5-MoE torch.compile degenerate output (#56900), GLM-5.2 MTP 0% draft acceptance on MI355X (#52833), and int8 per-token head scale overwriting Gated DeltaNet state (#63944).

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • No shipped release to adopt today. The performance items above are open PRs; treat them as “coming soon,” not available in a stable version.
  • Be cautious with disaggregated P/D and prefix caching. The NixlConnector lease-expiry bug can silently serve corrupted KV; validate outputs or avoid aggressive lease expiry until fixed.
  • Pin carefully for DeepSeek DSv4.1. v0.32.0 reportedly has no working block size on the release tag; wait for the #60762 fix or use a known-good build.
  • FP4 quantization requires TP alignment. If your TP split cuts a 16/32-element scale group, the new PR will refuse the load rather than silently produce wrong results — size TP ranks accordingly.
  • Responses API tool-calling has known gaps. previous_response_id can drop function-call history, and empty/refusal assistant turns can return HTTP 500. Gate agent workflows that replay prior turns until fixes land.
  • Hybrid models + speculative decoding remain a sharp edge. PP combinations and ≥3 attention groups with prefix caching are under-tested; prefer validated configurations for production.
  • Rust frontend is still experimental. VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 is a drop-in alternative but not feature-complete; do not assume parity with the Python API server.
  • Multimodal and long-context serving should benefit first from encoder CUDA graph and DSpark windowed-context work once merged.

llama.cpp — ggml-org/llama.cpp

llama.cpp Digest — 2026-11-07

1. Today's Highlights

llama.cpp shipped build b12180 with first-class support for Kimi-K3.1-Pro, a hybrid architecture that swaps the full-attention MLA layers for DeepSeek-style sparse attention (DSA) while keeping KDA linear-attention layers. Alongside the model work, the Vulkan backend now detects ReBAR and avoids BAR allocations when unsupported, and the MoE expert cache was rewritten as an LRFU/MQ-style hybrid (ClassLRU). The day's issue traffic was dominated by Intel Vulkan correctness problems and a server-side prompt-cache isolation bug that deserves attention from anyone running multi-tenant llama-server.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

Ten builds landed (b12170–b12180). No breaking API or config changes; all user-facing changes are additive.

  • b12180 — model: add Kimi-K3.1-Pro text model (#31779)
  • b12179 — hexagon: conv_2d optimizations and support for conv_3d (#31814)
  • b12177 — cli: fix crash on invalid UTF-8 in prompt or files (#31563) — upgrade if you feed untrusted or non-UTF-8 text through llama-cli
  • b12176 — tests: qualify isnan and signbit with std:: (#31791) — NetBSD/gcc 14.4 build fix
  • b12175 — tests: override hardware_concurrency in CI (#31797)
  • b12174 — cmake: generate RC file directly without win-app.rc.in (#31718)
  • b12173 — opencl: support repeat for f16, i32, i16, bf16 (#31782)
  • b12172 — webgpu: add batched tensor API (get_tensor_n / set_tensor_n) (#31473) — additive WebGPU binding surface
  • b12171 — vulkan: detect ReBAR support, avoid BAR allocations if unavailable (#31658)
  • b12170 — moe-cache: LRFU/MQ-like hybrid cache, ClassLRU (#31233)

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • Kimi-K3.1-Pro — hybrid K3 variant: 24 of 93 layers use a lightning indexer (32 heads × 128, top_k 2048, no RoPE) in place of full-attention MLA; the top-k mask implementation was extracted from build_attn for reuse. (#31779)
  • Hexagon: CONV_3D — new HTP_OP_CONV_3D wired through htp-ops.h, main.c and the op remap in htp-kparams.cpp, running on the existing HMX tiling path. (#31814)
  • Vulkan: ReBAR-aware allocation — BAR allocations are skipped on hardware/drivers without resizable BAR, which directly targets the slow-token-generation reports on AMD dGPUs with ReBAR disabled (#27097, now closed). (#31658)
  • OpenCL — repeat extended to f16, i32, i16 and bf16, closing another op-coverage gap for non-f32 paths. (#31782)
  • HIP/RDNA4 documentation — gfx1200/gfx1201 added to the supported GPU_TARGETS list. (#26745)
  • External PLE (engram) loading — new --shard argument plus conversion support for PLE-less and PLE-only GGUFs; still in review. (#31185)
  • Server UI — Discover now surfaces audio capability for models whose mmproj carries an audio encoder (Gemma 4, LFM 3 Omni). (#31837)

4. Performance & Optimization

  • Gemma 4 E2B/E4B graph optimizations — unused prompt tokens are dropped before KV-shared layers, eliminating compute for layers that do not contribute to the KV cache. Author reports "massive gains on pp." (#31356)
  • MoE cache redesign (ClassLRU) — LRFU/MQ-inspired hybrid eviction replacing the prior policy, with the clock advanced by real token counts. (#31233)
  • Hexagon: post-norm residual fusion — ADD(MUL(RMS_NORM(x), w), r) fused into RMS_NORM_MUL, removing one op launch and one DDR round trip twice per layer. (#31822)
  • HIP: fixed 32 MB BLAS workspace — avoids rocBLAS allocating scratch per call; test-backend-ops -o SOLVE_TRI went from HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT to 24/24 passing across 5 consecutive runs. (#31838)
  • CUDA NVFP4 quantization — Blackwell-native FP4 MMA at Q4_0 size with Q3_K-tier accuracy; measured +40% PP (≈20% on longer prompts). (#23572)
  • Vulkan: readonly on decodeBuf — preparation for a driver-side perf win. (#31833)
  • KleidiAI SME2 for CPU flash attention — routes eligible FLASH_ATTN_EXT QK/AV tile products through SME2 F32 kernels. (#29394)
  • Intel Vulkan FA prefill kernel — dedicated prefill shader for Intel platforms. (#29357)
  • --prefill-budget-busy — new server flag to bound prefill work while the server is under load. (#30992)
  • Checkpoint copy elimination — existing checkpoints are reused instead of re-copied. (#30683)

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. Prompt cache cross-conversation contamination (server, correctness/privacy). server_prompt_cache behind --cache-ram and --cache-idle-slots can restore KV state from an unrelated, already-finished conversation into a slot serving a new request under concurrent load. Open, no fix PR. (#27148)
  2. Vulkan KHR_coopmat nondeterministic wrong results on Intel Arc Pro B70 (BMG G31, Mesa 26.2.5). Same input yields a different answer on every call for a BERT-style model, diverging substantially from the CPU reference. Open. (#31560)
  3. Tokenizer SIGSEGV — stack overflow in unicode_regex_split_stl. The o200k/GPT-4o pre-tokenizer regex recurses once per character, so a ~26,000-character unbroken run of one character class kills llama-server. Remotely triggerable DoS if prompts are user-controlled. Open. (#27783)
  4. draft-dflash (DFlash2) abort in post_decode seq_rm on hybrid Qwen3.8-27B with --parallel 8. Open. (#31656)
  5. CUDA illegal memory access on GLM-5.3-Flash long prefill at -ub 2048 on Blackwell sm_120; reproduced only on the unmerged PR branch. (#28282)
  6. Vulkan/ANV: FA falling back to the SCALAR path causes O(N²) prompt-processing degradation and device loss on Intel Arc B580. Open. (#27638)
  7. gfx1201 FA dispatch threshold regression — head-size-256 WMMA threshold too low, ~20% speculative-decoding regression since #28102. Open. (#28867)
  8. SYCL dual Arc Pro B60 stall — --cpu-moe -sm layer with a 40,000 MiB MoE cache is ~100–1000× slower than single-GPU; 15,000 MiB completes. Open. (#31510)
  9. Memory leak reported on aarch64/CUDA builds. Open. (#27725)
  10. iGPU: CPU-resident layers allocate through the Vulkan host buffer, consuming device memory. Open. (#31538)
  11. MTP performance drop with n-max > 1 and -np > 1 under spec decoding + Vulkan. Open. (#27544)

Fixed / closed today: ReBAR-disabled Vulkan slowdown (#27097, addressed by b12171); draft-mtp determinism change on Qwen3.6 MTP (#23335); CUDA -cmoe illegal memory access on Turing sm_75 at 94 tokens (#28241); Qwen3-VL vision-embedding precision-floor noise (#29251); --cache-disk context offloading request closed (#20697).

In-review fixes worth tracking: JSON-schema allOf over plain types producing an empty-object grammar (#31834, fixes #31805); per-prompt-cache LoRA setting tracking to avoid restoring KV incompatible with the new task (#30275); --cache-reuse restoring stale checkpoints after a mid-prompt chunk deletion (#30683).

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • New frontier model, same binary. Kimi-K3.1-Pro runs on stock llama.cpp as of b12180 — but its hybrid DSA/KDA layout is new code, so validate output quality against a reference implementation before putting it in a production route.
  • Pin your build if you serve multiple tenants. The --cache-ram / --cache-idle-slots isolation bug (#27148) can leak prior conversation context into a fresh slot. Until it's fixed, either disable those flags or run one process per tenant.
  • Sanitize long prompts. The o200k tokenizer stack overflow (#27783) is reachable from a single API call; cap unbroken character runs or add a request-size guard at the gateway.
  • Vulkan on Intel is not production-safe yet. Nondeterministic coopmat results (#31560) and the SCALAR FA fallback cliff (#27638) argue for -DGGML_VULKAN_COOPMAT=OFF or a non-Vulkan backend on Arc hardware.
  • ReBAR detection removes a silent perf trap. b12171 means AMD Vulkan users no longer need to know their BAR configuration to get sane token-generation speed.
  • Structured output gets more reliable. The allOf grammar fix (#31834) addresses schemas that silently degraded to {} — relevant for tool-calling and agent frameworks relying on JSON-schema-constrained decoding.
  • Server roadmap is moving toward serving-grade features. Disaggregated prefill/decode (#21266, 35 comments), --prefill-budget-busy (#30992), per-cache-entry LoRA tracking (#30275) and a file upload API (#23948) all point to llama-server becoming a viable multi-tenant gateway rather than a single-user demo.

Ollama Digest — 2026-11-07

1. Today's Highlights

No new releases landed in the last 24 hours, but activity was heavy on the runtime side: the MLX backend picked up a long-awaited concurrency PR (#19197) that lets MLX models serve parallel generations via OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL, and a scheduler fix (#19581) targets a VRAM-leak path where ollama serve fails to reap an idle llama-server runner. The dominant theme, however, is Vulkan backend instability across AMD and Intel iGPUs on the 0.40.x llama-server-based builds, with three separate crash reports (AMD Renoir, Intel Lunar Lake, AMD Navi 14) all updated today.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

None. No releases in the last 24 hours.

Context worth flagging for anyone pinning versions: multiple issues updated today attribute behavior changes to the 0.40.x transition to a llama-server-based runner — #19158 explicitly notes gemma4:12b "worked on 0.34.4" and broke on 0.40.x, and #19558 reports crashes on both 0.40.14 stable and 0.40.15-rc2. Treat 0.40.x as a migration boundary for GPU backend selection, not a routine bump.

  • Issue #19158 — regression introduced by 0.40.x
  • Issue #19558 — affected versions enumerated

3. New Model & Hardware Support

Item Status Notes
PR #19580 — windows: add CUDA 13.5 and SM 103 for ARM64 CLOSED/merged Adds CUDA 13.5 + SM 103 for Windows ARM64; retains SM 121 support; other platforms unchanged. Expands usable NVIDIA hardware on ARM64 Windows.
PR #18078 — MLX: make Qwen3.8 Flash Next memory efficient CLOSED Replaces blanket NVFP4 quantization with a mixed scheme: QSA projections and the non-expert MTP path kept in BF16, MXFP8 for other eligible dense/control weights. Published as qwen3.8-flash-next:125b-a6b-nvfp4 and ...:125b-mlx.
Issue #19566 — MLX support for dense Nemotron / Luciole Safetensors OPEN, feature request v0.40.15 rejects direct Safetensors→MLX conversions with unsupported architecture: NemotronForCausalLM. The MLX runner registers Nemotron-H but not dense Nemotron (affects Luciole-1B and 23B). Reporter offers to contribute the patch.

Hardware gaps surfaced today (all Vulkan): AMD Renoir gfx90c (#19558), Intel Arc 130V / Lunar Lake (#19158), AMD RX 5500 / Navi 14 gfx1010 (#19589 — --list-devices fails with SIGBUS).

4. Performance & Optimization

  • PR #19197 — mlx: support concurrent generation (OPEN, updated today). Lets MLX models serve multiple concurrent generations through OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL, cutting time-to-first-token under load. Ready requests share projection and feed-forward compute; attention is kept per-request. Default remains 1 request — parallelism costs memory per active request. This is the most significant perf change in flight.
  • PR #19585 — llm: handle split memory log lines (OPEN, fixes #19204). memoryParsingWriter.Write() parsed each write independently, so log lines split across writes failed regex matching, producing inaccurate memory and VRAM accounting. Buffers incomplete lines between writes. Directly affects scheduler load decisions.
  • PR #19581 — sched: keep a runner we couldn't stop in the loaded set (OPEN, fixes #19577). Correctness fix with a perf consequence: a leaked runner's VRAM was treated as free, so the next load under-predicted available memory, tilted toward CPU offload, and spawned a second llama-server. Fixes the accounting chain that degrades throughput after a failed unload.
  • PR #18078 (see above) — targeted quantization to avoid the long-generation quality degradation seen with blanket NVFP4.

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. GPU falls off the bus (Xid 79) under grammar-constrained generation — Issue #17026 (OPEN). cuda_v13 backend, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, Ollama 0.30.10: long format-constrained generations crash with CUDA error: unspecified launch failure escalating to Xid 79. Same requests are fine on cuda_v12. No fix PR visible. Highest severity — requires host/GPU reset.
  2. Vulkan crash at model load on AMD Renoir iGPU — Issue #19558 (OPEN, filed today). llama-server exits with 0xe06d7363 (unhandled C++ exception) on Ryzen 4700U / gfx90c, for every model including ~380 MB ones, on 0.40.14 stable and 0.40.15-rc2. Vulkan backend is effectively unusable on this class of hardware.
  3. Vulkan device lost on Intel Arc 130V since 0.40.x — Issue #19158 (OPEN). gemma4:12b dies with ggml_vulkan: device lost on Vulkan0 immediately after tensor upload; regression from 0.34.4 with any GPU offload.
  4. Idle runner never reaped → VRAM leak — Issue #19577 (OPEN, filed today). At keep_alive expiry, ollama serve ignores the failed Close, marks the model unloaded, drops the runner from the scheduler, and logs nothing. The runner keeps all its VRAM; the next load sees too little free memory. Fix PR exists: #19581.
  5. AMD RX 5500 (Navi 14) undetected; SIGBUS on Vulkan — Issue #19589 (OPEN). llama-server --list-devices fails with signal: bus error (exit 135) under GGML_BACKEND Vulkan. Report includes a proposed fix.
  6. Intermittent 500 on /api/chat after a long streamed reply — Issue #19293 (OPEN). llama-server apply-template error … write: broken pipe, raised 2–3 s after the previous reply completes; runner stays healthy and an immediate retry succeeds. Affects 0.40.8 and 0.40.11 on macOS.
  7. ornith:35b renderer/parser leaks raw special tokens and tool-call XML — Issue #16992 (OPEN). Unparsed tool-call XML and special tokens reach OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible clients. Related parser fixes in flight: #19574 (stray <channel|> close tags in Gemma4Parser), #19590 (whitespace after </think> in deepseek3), #17021 (nesting depth for qwen3-coder tool-call close tags), #19588 (tool_result blocks missing ToolName on /v1/messages).
  8. ollama pull TLS handshake timeout on post-quantum-hostile networks — Issue #19430 (OPEN). Networks that silently drop TLS 1.3 ClientHellos carrying X25519MLKEM768 cause net/http: TLS handshake timeout against registry.ollama.ai. Relevant for locked-down corporate/edge egress.
  9. OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL + multimodal → failed processing images — Issue #4165 (CLOSED today after 24 comments). Long-standing interaction between parallel slots and vision models (llava, moondream) is now resolved/closed. Verify against your pinned version before relying on parallel multimodal serving.

Non-technical: Issue #19591 reports a duplicate $20 Stripe renewal on a cancelled account. Out of scope for infrastructure, but worth escalating to billing/support rather than the issue tracker.

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • Do not assume Vulkan works on iGPUs. Three independent crash classes (AMD Renoir, Intel Arc, AMD Navi 14) are open against 0.40.x. If you ship to consumer laptops or home-lab boxes, gate on backend detection and provide a CPU fallback; the Renoir case fails even on ~380 MB models, so "small model" is not a mitigation.
  • Pin to a known-good version and backend, not just a version. cuda_v13 and cuda_v12 diverge on the same hardware under constrained decoding (#17026). If you use format/JSON-schema-constrained generation heavily, prefer cuda_v12 until #17026 is addressed.
  • Make /api/chat retries idempotent-safe. The post-reply 500 in #19293 is transient and retry-succeeds — a single retry with backoff is a cheap, effective mitigation. Don't surface it to users as a hard failure.
  • Treat tool-call parsing as untrusted output. #16992 plus the four parser PRs landing today show the renderer/parser layer still leaks raw control tokens and malformed tool-call XML into client-visible streams. Validate tool-call payloads before executing them, and don't assume OpenAI/Anthropic compatibility is byte-exact for structured output.
  • Memory accounting is currently unreliable — don't trust reported VRAM. The combination of #19577 (silent leaked runner) and #19585 (split log lines break memory parsing) means /api/ps and scheduler decisions can be wrong. If you run multi-model workloads or long keep_alive, monitor GPU memory out-of-band.
  • Parallelism is expanding beyond the llama.cpp backend. MLX models gain OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL support via #19197 (default still 1). Budget VRAM per concurrent request before raising it, and note that the multimodal + parallel path was only just closed (#4165) — retest rather than assume.
  • Watch CUDA 13.5 / SM 103 on Windows ARM64 (#19580) if you're targeting Snapdragon-class dev machines or ARM64 CI runners with discrete NVIDIA GPUs.

  1. #48145 — JSON-defined openai-like providers lose tools when model is not in catalog (OPEN, bug/llm translation) — regression introduced between 1.81 and 1.106: tool definitions are silently dropped for models like nano-gpt/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash unless declared as openai. Silent capability loss for agents. No fix PR linked yet.
  2. #47046 — Vertex/Gemini context caching reorders the conversation (OPEN) — a cache_control block that is not a prefix gets moved ahead of history and modify_params drops system_instruction, so the model answers the previous user turn. Correctness bug with no visible error.
  3. #47924 — reasoning_effort="none" omits thinking instead of disabling it (OPEN, 1 👍) — on default-on Claude models, removing the thinking config leaves the upstream default in effect, so "none" costs more than asked.
  4. #47577 — Gemini _build_vertex_schema + streaming drops native_finish_reason on mid-stream MALFORMED_FUNCTION_CALL (OPEN) — trailing tool calls silently dropped on both /v1/messages and /v1/chat/completions.
  5. #50248 — COHERE_API_BASE ignored for cohere embeddings (OPEN) — always hits hardcoded api.cohere.ai/v2/embed; the rerank path honors the same variable, so private-endpoint deployments break only on embeddings.
  6. #50317 — daily tag spend lost after Redis dequeue if writer exits before DB commit (OPEN) — billing data loss window between Redis buffer and PostgreSQL commit; reproduced with two writer processes.
  7. #45584 — Langfuse callback drops traces for /v1/systemone and /v1/decisions (OPEN) — DecisionsUsage has no .get, trace silently discarded.
  8. #36280 — pass_through_endpoints with include_subpath rejected for virtual keys (OPEN) — wildcard route is registered but classified as a management route, returning 401 to all non-admin keys.

Fixes landed or in review:

  • #50470 — preserves streamed tool argument fragments verbatim; fixes corrupted structured output when a fragment like 5e7650… is parsed as standalone JSON.
  • #49183 — per-tool-call index for ollama_chat/, which previously glued multiple calls' arguments into one.
  • #50445 — records retries and fallback hops after a request's first logged failure, so allowed_fails/cooldown/RPM actually see repeated 429s.
  • #50432 — skips cooldown on 404 for single-deployment groups; one bad request shape no longer locks everyone out.
  • #50489 — releases redacted buffered stream content; previously masked text could leak in responses and chat deltas.
  • #50488 — preserves routing tags through pre-call guardrails, which were hiding them and silently selecting the default deployment.
  • #46844 — Gemini pass-through sends the key in x-goog-api-key instead of ?key=, closing a URL-logging credential exposure.

Closed this window: #25869 (Gemini stream_chunk_builder corrupting server_side_tool_invocations/thought_signatures), #48384 (Anthropic server_tool_use returned as a pending tool_call, causing agent loops), #47396 (budget reservation priced at max_input_tokens on /v1/messages with Anthropic tool_choice), #35570, #46999, #29638, #49038.

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • Audit any model you declare as a JSON-defined openai-like provider. #48145 means tools can be dropped without an error if the model string isn't in the catalog — verify tool_calls actually arrive before shipping an agent on a custom provider entry.
  • Streaming + tools is the riskiest surface right now. The highest-value fixes (#50470, #49183) are still open; if you stream structured output or multi-tool responses through Anthropic/Vertex/Bedrock/Ollama, pin your version and test argument reassembly explicitly.
  • Don't rely on reasoning_effort: "none" to cut cost on Claude. #47924 leaves upstream thinking enabled — set the provider-native thinking-disable parameter instead until it lands.
  • If you use chatgpt/ behind /v1/messages, the encrypted-reasoning backport (#50456) is the one to track on the LTS branch; without it every tool turn re-reasons from scratch, inflating both latency and token spend.
  • For SAP AI Core deployments, budget ~870ms of per-call overhead (#47096) until deployment_url is cached — relevant for any tight agent loop.
  • Plan for the OpenAI SDK 3 bump (#47762) in your image build pipeline; it carries a transport fix but is a dependency major.
Unsloth — unslothai/unsloth

Unsloth Digest — 2026-11-07

Scope note: the activity in this window is dominated by Unsloth Studio / Desktop (the local inference + fine-tuning app), not the core unsloth training library. Release notes for v0.1.916-beta were truncated in the source data.

1. Today's Highlights

Unsloth shipped v0.1.916-beta ("Large Performance Fixes"), targeting long-chat typing/search latency, image and video load times, and adding two-GPU image/video generation plus per-chat browsers — the release is a client-side responsiveness push on top of continued Glass-theme work. In parallel, @danielhanchen landed/opened a cluster of diffusion-path fixes: returning freed heap to the OS after image loads (#16934) and eliminating redundant Triton autotuning on warm starts, worth ~9.5 s of a 22 s first SDXL render on an L4 (#16981). The counterweight is a set of still-open Windows/GPU regressions: a reproducible Krea 2 Turbo load crash (#16892), DiffusionGemma multi-GPU abort above ~1792 tokens (#16925), and image generation silently falling back to CPU on an RTX 3060 (#16803).

Repo velocity: 42 issues and 213 PRs updated in the last 24 h.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

  • v0.1.916-beta — "Large Performance Fixes" Faster typing and search in long chats; faster image/video loads; two-GPU image/video gen; separate browser per chat; floating browser window; additional Glass theme optimizations. No documented API/config breakage. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/releases

  • transformers 5.23 checkpointing rename (tracked, issue closed) — gradient_checkpointing → activation_checkpointing. Old names persist as aliases until v6, but Trainer now reads only the new names, changing behavior in 4 call sites in this repo (audited at f5adb36642). Anyone pinning transformers should pin <5.23 or patch. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16667

  • MCP SDK 2.3.0 incompatibility (resolved) — Blender MCP failed to start under v0.1.915-beta with MCP SDK 2.3.0 / FastMCP 4.1.6; closed during this window. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16878

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • LFM3-Audio-2B — now trainable in Studio, chattable post-training, and exportable as LoRA, merged 16-bit, and GGUF. Fixes a TokenizersBackend has no attribute ... failure at first-batch build. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16973
  • Cosmos3 (Edge + Nano) — 256p generation, NVIDIA's published frame ranges, and a per-model frame-rate picker; Nano video continuation (extend a clip from its last or first frames) stacked on top. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16737 · https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16741
  • Two-GPU image/video generation — shipped in v0.1.916-beta (see caveat in §5 for multi-GPU text/diffusion models).
  • Unified-memory quant fit badges — request to make fit badges visible/accurate on unified-memory laptops (Apple Silicon class); open. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/13947
  • Transformer block swap (layer offload to RAM) — long-standing feature request closed this window. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/3997
  • Per-model extended parameters (YaRN context extension without a separate unsloth run launch) and download speed limiting — both closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/7589 · https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/15603

4. Performance & Optimization

Landed / in review:

  • Diffusion warm-start autotune caching — a compiled diffusion load with a warm compile cache re-benchmarked every multi-config Triton reduction on each Studio reopen. On SDXL / L4: ~40 kernels, ~9.5 s of a 22 s first render, repeated every time. PR reads back the workers' autotune results instead. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16981
  • Heap return after image load — glibc keeps freed chunks below the mmap threshold in arenas, so staging copies stayed counted as used host RAM after weights were pinned/uploaded. PR returns that heap to the OS. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16934
  • WebKit restyle cost — closing any dialog or menu on long chats took 5–7 s on macOS WebKit and WebKitGTK; opening the browser pane on Linux WebKit took >20 s. Root cause: WebKit restyles every element on certain document mutations. Closed; CI gate allowances tightened afterward. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16961 · https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16978
  • Reduce-motion theme switch — light/dark flip took ~2.5 s vs ~230 ms with Reduce motion off (Windows Desktop), because a transition was started on every element. Fix in review. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16977
  • Long-conversation UI lag regression (web + desktop) — closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16603

Open, with measurements:

  • RAG ingest is batch-of-1 across documents — _embed_all (core/rag/ingestion.py:166) is called per document; _EMBED_BATCH only batches chunks within a document. Measured ~99 ms/chunk on the batch-of-1 path vs 2.07 ms batched — a ~48× gap for corpora of small files (notes, docs, wikis). https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16715

5. Stability & Regressions

Critical — crashes / hard aborts

  1. DiffusionGemma multi-GPU: prompts over ~1792 tokens abort the visual server — GGML_ASSERT n_ubatch >= n_tokens. Reproduced on 2× CUDA (RTX 3060 12 GB sm 8.6 + RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB sm 8.9), Windows 11, Studio API mode. No fix PR yet; effectively caps multi-GPU diffusion prompt length. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16925
  2. Krea 2 Turbo fails to load on Windows — 0xc0000005 access violation in the Studio backend, reproducible via Images → select unsloth/Krea-2-Turbo. No fix PR yet. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16892
  3. Desktop crash on v0.1.915-beta (Win 11, RTX 4060 Ti) — closed this window. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16816

High — functional breakage

  1. web_search always returns "No results found." — the ddgs request lacks an Accept header (DuckDuckGo returns 202), and yandex is missing from the engine allow-list. Any agent relying on Studio's search tool is silently non-functional. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16664
  2. search_conversation tool disappeared — third occurrence. Recurring tool-registration regression; no fix PR. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16706
  3. Image generation falls back to CPU/RAM on Windows 11 + RTX 3060 while text generation correctly uses the GPU; not reproducible on an M1 Pro. No fix PR. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16803
  4. Beta update does not complete on Desktop. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16897

Medium — correctness

  1. CLI treats a truncated stream as success — if Studio's HTTP response ends after a text delta but before a finish reason or [DONE], unsloth inference exits 0 with a partial answer and unsloth chat stores it as assistant history. Closed; relevant to anyone parsing these streams. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16867
  2. S3 dataset filename collisions — distinct object keys mapped to one local filename, silently pairing transcripts with the wrong recording; manifest shards could overwrite each other. Fix PR closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16830
  3. S3 audio JSONL prep fails on U+2028/U+2029 inside transcripts — one bad row blocks training. Closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16721
  4. RAG indexing during embedding-model download fails every file with EmbeddingModelDownloadRequiredError; nothing queues. Closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16714
  5. gemma-4-thinking chat template strips reasoning — closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16699

Low — UI / cosmetic (all closed): Glass setting not applied consistently (#16770), Glass theme blurs entire background (#16820), wallpaper hidden in active chats by CSS specificity (#16736), model-selection resets across multi-model conversations (#14506).

Flaky CI: Inline images (windows-latest) failed twice today on unrelated PRs, both Firefox-only, on the same Japanese-filename check; PR adds a bounded grace period and timeout diagnostics. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16923

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • Don't trust a stream that ends without a terminal marker. The CLI previously treated a truncated response as a successful reply and persisted it as history (#16867). If you proxy Studio's HTTP API, validate for finish_reason or [DONE] yourself — the same failure mode will surface in your own client code.
  • Search-backed agents are degraded right now. web_search returns empty results unconditionally on current builds (#16664), and search_conversation has vanished for the third time (#16706). Pin a known-good version or stub the tool rather than assuming tool-call availability at startup.
  • Multi-GPU diffusion has a hard prompt-length ceiling. The n_ubatch >= n_tokens abort above ~1792 tokens (#16925) means long-prompt image workflows should stay single-GPU or chunk prompts until fixed.
  • RAG ingest cost is dominated by per-document embedding calls, not chunk count (#16715). For many-small-files corpora, batching at the ingestion layer is the highest-leverage workaround (~48× measured gap).
  • State is moving server-side. Preferences previously in localStorage are being synced per account (#16912, #16958); idle-unloaded GGUFs now reload with their original launch settings instead of defaults (#16927). If you depend on deterministic reload behavior, that's a fix — but verify context/KV-cache settings survive idle unload on your build.
  • Claude Pro/Max plans become usable without an API key via a claude CLI-backed Agent connection through Anthropic's Agent SDK (#16963) — worth watching if you're consolidating agent backends behind Studio.
  • Audio fine-tuning is broadening with LFM3-Audio-2B train → chat → export (LoRA / merged 16-bit / GGUF) in one flow (#16973).
  • Pin transformers < 5.23 until the checkpointing rename is fully absorbed (#16667).

item.content:encoded:
AI Infrastructure Digest 2026-11-07

Generated: 2026-11-07 02:20 UTC | Projects covered: 6

  • vLLM
  • SGLang
  • llama.cpp
  • Ollama
  • LiteLLM
  • Unsloth

Cross-Project Comparison

⚠️ Comparative analysis generation failed.

Per-Project Reports

vLLM — vllm-project/vllm

vLLM Digest — 2026-11-07

1. Today's Highlights

No new vLLM releases landed in the last 24 hours; activity is concentrated in open PRs and long-running design threads. The Rust frontend parity roadmap continues to attract the most discussion (#44280), while the Q4 2026 roadmap was published (#61024). Performance work spans ROCm DSpark/MLA paths, FP8 prefill, MoE DP padding, and multimodal encoder CUDA graphs; stability attention remains on disaggregated KV transfer and hybrid-model correctness.

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • Kimi-K3 FP8 MLA on ROCm gfx1250 — open PR adds AITER FP8 MHA plus MLA prefill/decode paths, scoped to Kimi-K3 with FP8 KV cache; other models/arches retain existing paths. PR #66208
  • DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 DSpark on ROCm — PR stacks context WKV projections, replacing three per-layer GEMMs with one combined GEMM. PR #66212
  • GPT-OSS MXFP4 on ROCm AITER fused MoE — fix forwards quant_config.gemm1_clamp_limit (GPT-OSS uses 7.0) into AITER, which previously only read moe_config.swiglu_limit. PR #66210
  • Nemotron 3.5 ASR streaming — feature request for nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b, a 600M multilingual streaming ASR model. Issue #47455
  • GLM-5.3 optimization — follow-up to prior GLM work; same glm_moe_dsa architecture as GLM-5.2, with remaining CUDA and kernel opportunities tracked. Issue #57406
  • Rust frontend parity — experimental Rust API-server replacement via VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1; roadmap tracks missing features relative to the Python frontend. Issue #44280
  • ReplaySSM for SSM/linear-attention decode — RFC proposes caching SSM inputs rather than state for Mamba2 and Gated DeltaNet, targeting decode memory bandwidth. Issue #47572
  • Large-page KV cache allocator — RFC for one KV cache group per spec, motivated by hybrid models requiring different page sizes. Issue #64401
  • Engine-neutral sharded weight transfer — “load plan” RFC for NCCL/M2N and sharded RDMA/NIXL engines to know which tensor slices each rank needs and where they land. Issue #64418
  • MiMo-V2 omni video timestamps — bugfix labels video grids with sampled frames’ actual media time instead of fixed 1-second spacing. PR #66201

4. Performance & Optimization

  • FP8 prefill page expansion on SM120 — bounded conversion of referenced FP8 KV pages into BF16 scratch; recorded paired cold-prefill tests showed up to 10.1% input-token throughput improvement, while retaining FP8 storage. PR #64942
  • MoE DP padding skip — avoids processing padded rows in FlashInfer TRT-LLM monolithic MoE kernels under data parallelism on Blackwell block-FP8/MXFP8 checkpoints. PR #65972
  • Multimodal encoder CUDA graphs — moves from greedy splitting into multiple padded replays toward one replay per batch, with a finer grid up to the max token budget. PR #65227
  • DSpark windowed draft context — computes context K/V precompute and main_proj only for trailing rows when all KV groups are sliding-window; targets long-context drafting (16K-token example cited). PR #60320
  • DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MegaMoE locality placement — opt-in placement of expert weights in the GPU memory locality domain of the SMs that read them via DeepGEMM’s locality allocator. PR #64835
  • Direct weight reload rollout — models must opt in; known-silent reload paths are refused, preparing VLLM_RELOAD_MODE=direct to become default. PR #66002
  • Speculative-decoding oracle benchmark — reference-replay benchmark compares real draft methods (EAGLE, n-gram, etc.) against saved target-model output on the same prompts. PR #62258
  • Rust preprocessing benchmark — community comparison of Rust vs. PyTorch preprocessing performance. Issue #47601
  • Regression watch: MoE decode reported ~15% slower on SM12x since DeepGEMM contiguous-layout alignment changed from 64 to 128. Issue #58624
  • P/D descriptor overhead: GLM-5.3 P/D on GB200 with NIXL sees 91k–120k KV descriptors per TP-rank transfer, making descriptor submission, not fabric bandwidth, the bottleneck. Issue #55434

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. Silent KV corruption in NixlConnector P/D — producer releases KV blocks on lease expiry while a remote READ is still in flight; decode can consume overwritten KV with no error. Issue #61229
  2. Illegal memory access / gibberish on Qwen3.8-27B GDN hybrid with PP=3 — Xid 31 with prefix caching, incorrect output without it; regression since v0.28.0 across v0.31.0/v0.32.0 and both model runners. Issue #63505
  3. TP worker hang → EngineDeadError — RPC sample_tokens timeout with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, TP=8, MTP speculative decoding; high community attention (8 👍). Issue #41530
  4. FP4 TP splits cutting compressed-tensors scale groups — NVFP4/MXFP4 row-parallel and MoE w2 layers could silently multiply FP4 codes by other groups’ scales. Fix PR refuses invalid splits. PR #66213
  5. DeepSeek DSv4.1 v0.32.0 block-size failure — neither 64 nor 128 works on the release tag; issue closed with fix tracked in #60762. Issue #59203
  6. Marlin MoE batch invariance — output depends on equivalent within-expert token ordering, affecting deterministic/batch-invariant serving. Issue #52525
  7. Hybrid models with ≥3 attention groups + EAGLE/MTP + prefix caching untested — block-drop behavior not validated for DeepSeek-V4-Flash/DSpark-class models. Issue #51771
  8. Qwen3.5 hybrid GDN + dflash speculative decoding + PP — missing supports_aux_hidden_states_over_pp opt-in blocks the combination. Issue #60765
  9. Responses API drops tool-call items — previous_response_id loses function_call/function_call_output from stored context. Issue #43244
  10. Responses API HTTP 500 on empty/refusal content — replaying a prior assistant turn with empty or refusal content crashes _construct_message_from_response_item; fix PR open. Issue #49130
  11. Packed weight-transfer misalignment — odd-sized packed NCCL/IPC entries shift later entries; fix copies misaligned slices on unpack. PR #65487
  12. Dequant identity dtype mismatch — generic fallback builds identity in out_dtype but feeds it as an activation; fix builds it in the layer’s activation dtype. PR #66209
  13. CI/eval fixes — ROCm test_block_fp8.py skip condition corrected (PR #66205); B200 nightly gsm8k eval failures fixed via config-only changes for ReplaySSM, Kimi-K3 DSpark, and DeepEP LL (PR #66207).

Also closed in this window: Qwen1.5-MoE torch.compile degenerate output (#56900), GLM-5.2 MTP 0% draft acceptance on MI355X (#52833), and int8 per-token head scale overwriting Gated DeltaNet state (#63944).

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • No shipped release to adopt today. The performance items above are open PRs; treat them as “coming soon,” not available in a stable version.
  • Be cautious with disaggregated P/D and prefix caching. The NixlConnector lease-expiry bug can silently serve corrupted KV; validate outputs or avoid aggressive lease expiry until fixed.
  • Pin carefully for DeepSeek DSv4.1. v0.32.0 reportedly has no working block size on the release tag; wait for the #60762 fix or use a known-good build.
  • FP4 quantization requires TP alignment. If your TP split cuts a 16/32-element scale group, the new PR will refuse the load rather than silently produce wrong results — size TP ranks accordingly.
  • Responses API tool-calling has known gaps. previous_response_id can drop function-call history, and empty/refusal assistant turns can return HTTP 500. Gate agent workflows that replay prior turns until fixes land.
  • Hybrid models + speculative decoding remain a sharp edge. PP combinations and ≥3 attention groups with prefix caching are under-tested; prefer validated configurations for production.
  • Rust frontend is still experimental. VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1 is a drop-in alternative but not feature-complete; do not assume parity with the Python API server.
  • Multimodal and long-context serving should benefit first from encoder CUDA graph and DSpark windowed-context work once merged.
SGLang — sgl-project/sglang

SGLang Digest — 2026-11-07

Source: github.com/sgl-project/sglang — issues and PRs updated in the last 24h (64 issues, 500 PRs; top 30 / top 20 by comment count reviewed).

1. Today's Highlights

The dominant thread is Kimi-K3.1 Day-0 enablement: PR #48414 lands the full serving stack (DSA with decode context parallelism, PD disaggregation, DFlash speculative decoding, PP prefill, HiSparse, fused kernels), with a TP-sharding follow-up already merged. In parallel, a large batch of AMD/ROCm and Intel XPU kernel work moved through review, and two silent-correctness bugs surfaced that matter to anyone running reasoning models or prefix caching through the gateway.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

No new releases in the last 24h. No API-breaking changes landed.

Config surface additions in flight (not yet merged):

  • --hicache-mamba-size-gb to pin the HiCache Mamba host pool size — PR #47867
  • --layernorm-sp-min-tokens to run small extend passes replicated instead of sequence-parallel — PR #48947
  • --hicache-swa-host-ratio for hybrid sliding-window/full-attention HiCache pools — PR #48950

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • Kimi-K3.1 (KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration) — Day-0 serving stack: DSA + decode context parallelism, PD disaggregation, DFlash spec decode, PP prefill, HiSparse, fused kernels. Basic model support already on main via #48415 — PR #48414
  • AMD Q4 2026 roadmap — Helios rack-scale, MI45x (gfx1250), Ryzen AI Halo (gfx1151/1152), Monokernel work — Issue #46462
  • Intel XPU (Xe2 / Battlemage) — FP8 dense layers can now run weight-only (W8A16) via sgl_kernel.fp8_linear; the W8A8 path is slower than bf16 on parts without an FP8 matrix engine — PR #48787
  • Apple Silicon — RFC for a Torch-owned SRT path with an exported whole-model MLX region; implementation at #36164 — Issue #32321
  • Ascend — RFC to integrate MindIE-SD as an optional acceleration library for SGLang Diffusion (dense quantized + sparse attention) — Issue #48582
  • Weight transfer — native ModelExpress backend via POST /update_weights_from_modelexpress, aimed at trainer→server weight sync loops — PR #42103

4. Performance & Optimization

Speculative decoding / DFlash

  • Kimi-K3.1 decode MoE front + latent-up tail TP-sharded (merged): each TP rank previously read the full 12.9 MB router and 51.4 MB latent down-proj per layer, plus 51.4 MB up_proj — PR #48584
  • DFlash verify: side-stream context projection and a single-kernel verify commit — PR #48948
  • dspark: build the compact verify window and stage its padded layout in one launch each — PR #48833
  • kda-replayssm: reuse verify-fused commit step indices, removing ~17 eager kernel launches per verify step — PR #44396

AMD / ROCm

  • Kimi-K3 on MI355X: emit AITER moe_sorting directly from the radix-4 router launch, cutting one of three pre-GEMM launches at M ≤ 64 tokens/MoE call — PR #43126
  • Quark FP8 KDA in-proj and MLA absorb routed onto FP8 kernels (MI355X decode is latency-bound) — PR #44362
  • Segmented split-K bf16 matmul for gfx950 in deterministic/batch-invariant mode — PR #45599
  • Qwen3-Next: fuse Q/K GemmaRMSNorm + partial RoPE into one Triton kernel on gfx950 — PR #48044

Kernels & sampling

  • reject_sampling: vocabulary-tiled final-token pass for small-batch spec sampling — PR #48949
  • Unified FP32 activation library in sgl_kernel/activation.cuh, incl. silu_fast for latency-bound fused quantization — PR #48942
  • DeepSeek-V4.1: compact-verify ratio-1/2 compressors moved off the general torch path onto fused kernels — PR #48832
  • DSV4.1 indexer consumers score only candidate positions rather than all visible K — PR #46003

Roadmap-level

  • Weight Cache Daemon: post-quantized weights served over CUDA IPC, weight load ~306–327 s → <1 s on Qwen3-235B FP8 — Issue #33522
  • GLM-5.3-Flash Hopper (SM90) optimization tracker — Issue #45373

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity (silent correctness first):

  1. FP8 KV-cache scales silently ignored — attention built without quant_config on GLM-4.5, Llama 4, Qwen3-MoE, GPT-OSS, HunYuan, HY3, K-EXAONE, LFM2. Silent quality degradation, no error. — Issue #48749
  2. Reasoning parser truncates on quoted </think> — first-occurrence split cuts reasoning_content and leaks the remainder of the CoT into content. — Issue #48791
  3. GLM-5.3-Flash thinking degenerates into repeated ! under complex system prompt + multiple tools + tool_choice=auto. — Issue #36669
  4. Model gateway drops cache_salt on /v1/chat/completions before forwarding — same request behaves differently direct vs. via gateway. — Issue #48793
  5. CI regression on main: test_kandinsky6_sr_decode_parallel spatial-2 fails since #48366 (max abs diff 9); fix PR open — Issue #48892 / PR #48903
  6. HiCache + Mooncake cache hit-rate dip under L2/L3 capacity pressure (87.4% → sharp drop mid-benchmark). — Issue #47481
  7. Closed/resolved today: fast_topk_v2 returning wrong top-k sets when a radix bucket exceeds its 4096-entry buffer at k=2048 (#36807); PP-disaggregated prefill deadlock under abort storms, RCA + fix series (#34572); spec-decode OOM mid-traffic with large draft windows and no upfront capacity check (#38341).
  8. CI health: tracker reports 1 broken, 4 flaky, 1164 recently fixed — Issue #17050; flaky/CI-infra tracker at Issue #42752; CUDA coredump auto-tracker at Issue #26340.

6. What This Means for Application Developers

llama.cpp Digest — 2026-11-07

1. Today's Highlights

llama.cpp shipped build b12180 with first-class support for Kimi-K3.1-Pro, a hybrid architecture that swaps the full-attention MLA layers for DeepSeek-style sparse attention (DSA) while keeping KDA linear-attention layers. Alongside the model work, the Vulkan backend now detects ReBAR and avoids BAR allocations when unsupported, and the MoE expert cache was rewritten as an LRFU/MQ-style hybrid (ClassLRU). The day's issue traffic was dominated by Intel Vulkan correctness problems and a server-side prompt-cache isolation bug that deserves attention from anyone running multi-tenant llama-server.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

Ten builds landed (b12170–b12180). No breaking API or config changes; all user-facing changes are additive.

  • b12180 — model: add Kimi-K3.1-Pro text model (#31779)
  • b12179 — hexagon: conv_2d optimizations and support for conv_3d (#31814)
  • b12177 — cli: fix crash on invalid UTF-8 in prompt or files (#31563) — upgrade if you feed untrusted or non-UTF-8 text through llama-cli
  • b12176 — tests: qualify isnan and signbit with std:: (#31791) — NetBSD/gcc 14.4 build fix
  • b12175 — tests: override hardware_concurrency in CI (#31797)
  • b12174 — cmake: generate RC file directly without win-app.rc.in (#31718)
  • b12173 — opencl: support repeat for f16, i32, i16, bf16 (#31782)
  • b12172 — webgpu: add batched tensor API (get_tensor_n / set_tensor_n) (#31473) — additive WebGPU binding surface
  • b12171 — vulkan: detect ReBAR support, avoid BAR allocations if unavailable (#31658)
  • b12170 — moe-cache: LRFU/MQ-like hybrid cache, ClassLRU (#31233)

3. New Model & Hardware Support

  • Kimi-K3.1-Pro — hybrid K3 variant: 24 of 93 layers use a lightning indexer (32 heads × 128, top_k 2048, no RoPE) in place of full-attention MLA; the top-k mask implementation was extracted from build_attn for reuse. (#31779)
  • Hexagon: CONV_3D — new HTP_OP_CONV_3D wired through htp-ops.h, main.c and the op remap in htp-kparams.cpp, running on the existing HMX tiling path. (#31814)
  • Vulkan: ReBAR-aware allocation — BAR allocations are skipped on hardware/drivers without resizable BAR, which directly targets the slow-token-generation reports on AMD dGPUs with ReBAR disabled (#27097, now closed). (#31658)
  • OpenCL — repeat extended to f16, i32, i16 and bf16, closing another op-coverage gap for non-f32 paths. (#31782)
  • HIP/RDNA4 documentation — gfx1200/gfx1201 added to the supported GPU_TARGETS list. (#26745)
  • External PLE (engram) loading — new --shard argument plus conversion support for PLE-less and PLE-only GGUFs; still in review. (#31185)
  • Server UI — Discover now surfaces audio capability for models whose mmproj carries an audio encoder (Gemma 4, LFM 3 Omni). (#31837)

4. Performance & Optimization

  • Gemma 4 E2B/E4B graph optimizations — unused prompt tokens are dropped before KV-shared layers, eliminating compute for layers that do not contribute to the KV cache. Author reports "massive gains on pp." (#31356)
  • MoE cache redesign (ClassLRU) — LRFU/MQ-inspired hybrid eviction replacing the prior policy, with the clock advanced by real token counts. (#31233)
  • Hexagon: post-norm residual fusion — ADD(MUL(RMS_NORM(x), w), r) fused into RMS_NORM_MUL, removing one op launch and one DDR round trip twice per layer. (#31822)
  • HIP: fixed 32 MB BLAS workspace — avoids rocBLAS allocating scratch per call; test-backend-ops -o SOLVE_TRI went from HSA_STATUS_ERROR_MEMORY_FAULT to 24/24 passing across 5 consecutive runs. (#31838)
  • CUDA NVFP4 quantization — Blackwell-native FP4 MMA at Q4_0 size with Q3_K-tier accuracy; measured +40% PP (≈20% on longer prompts). (#23572)
  • Vulkan: readonly on decodeBuf — preparation for a driver-side perf win. (#31833)
  • KleidiAI SME2 for CPU flash attention — routes eligible FLASH_ATTN_EXT QK/AV tile products through SME2 F32 kernels. (#29394)
  • Intel Vulkan FA prefill kernel — dedicated prefill shader for Intel platforms. (#29357)
  • --prefill-budget-busy — new server flag to bound prefill work while the server is under load. (#30992)
  • Checkpoint copy elimination — existing checkpoints are reused instead of re-copied. (#30683)

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. Prompt cache cross-conversation contamination (server, correctness/privacy). server_prompt_cache behind --cache-ram and --cache-idle-slots can restore KV state from an unrelated, already-finished conversation into a slot serving a new request under concurrent load. Open, no fix PR. (#27148)
  2. Vulkan KHR_coopmat nondeterministic wrong results on Intel Arc Pro B70 (BMG G31, Mesa 26.2.5). Same input yields a different answer on every call for a BERT-style model, diverging substantially from the CPU reference. Open. (#31560)
  3. Tokenizer SIGSEGV — stack overflow in unicode_regex_split_stl. The o200k/GPT-4o pre-tokenizer regex recurses once per character, so a ~26,000-character unbroken run of one character class kills llama-server. Remotely triggerable DoS if prompts are user-controlled. Open. (#27783)
  4. draft-dflash (DFlash2) abort in post_decode seq_rm on hybrid Qwen3.8-27B with --parallel 8. Open. (#31656)
  5. CUDA illegal memory access on GLM-5.3-Flash long prefill at -ub 2048 on Blackwell sm_120; reproduced only on the unmerged PR branch. (#28282)
  6. Vulkan/ANV: FA falling back to the SCALAR path causes O(N²) prompt-processing degradation and device loss on Intel Arc B580. Open. (#27638)
  7. gfx1201 FA dispatch threshold regression — head-size-256 WMMA threshold too low, ~20% speculative-decoding regression since #28102. Open. (#28867)
  8. SYCL dual Arc Pro B60 stall — --cpu-moe -sm layer with a 40,000 MiB MoE cache is ~100–1000× slower than single-GPU; 15,000 MiB completes. Open. (#31510)
  9. Memory leak reported on aarch64/CUDA builds. Open. (#27725)
  10. iGPU: CPU-resident layers allocate through the Vulkan host buffer, consuming device memory. Open. (#31538)
  11. MTP performance drop with n-max > 1 and -np > 1 under spec decoding + Vulkan. Open. (#27544)

Fixed / closed today: ReBAR-disabled Vulkan slowdown (#27097, addressed by b12171); draft-mtp determinism change on Qwen3.6 MTP (#23335); CUDA -cmoe illegal memory access on Turing sm_75 at 94 tokens (#28241); Qwen3-VL vision-embedding precision-floor noise (#29251); --cache-disk context offloading request closed (#20697).

In-review fixes worth tracking: JSON-schema allOf over plain types producing an empty-object grammar (#31834, fixes #31805); per-prompt-cache LoRA setting tracking to avoid restoring KV incompatible with the new task (#30275); --cache-reuse restoring stale checkpoints after a mid-prompt chunk deletion (#30683).

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • New frontier model, same binary. Kimi-K3.1-Pro runs on stock llama.cpp as of b12180 — but its hybrid DSA/KDA layout is new code, so validate output quality against a reference implementation before putting it in a production route.
  • Pin your build if you serve multiple tenants. The --cache-ram / --cache-idle-slots isolation bug (#27148) can leak prior conversation context into a fresh slot. Until it's fixed, either disable those flags or run one process per tenant.
  • Sanitize long prompts. The o200k tokenizer stack overflow (#27783) is reachable from a single API call; cap unbroken character runs or add a request-size guard at the gateway.
  • Vulkan on Intel is not production-safe yet. Nondeterministic coopmat results (#31560) and the SCALAR FA fallback cliff (#27638) argue for -DGGML_VULKAN_COOPMAT=OFF or a non-Vulkan backend on Arc hardware.
  • ReBAR detection removes a silent perf trap. b12171 means AMD Vulkan users no longer need to know their BAR configuration to get sane token-generation speed.
  • Structured output gets more reliable. The allOf grammar fix (#31834) addresses schemas that silently degraded to {} — relevant for tool-calling and agent frameworks relying on JSON-schema-constrained decoding.
  • Server roadmap is moving toward serving-grade features. Disaggregated prefill/decode (#21266, 35 comments), --prefill-budget-busy (#30992), per-cache-entry LoRA tracking (#30275) and a file upload API (#23948) all point to llama-server becoming a viable multi-tenant gateway rather than a single-user demo.

Ollama Digest — 2026-11-07

1. Today's Highlights

No new releases landed in the last 24 hours, but activity was heavy on the runtime side: the MLX backend picked up a long-awaited concurrency PR (#19197) that lets MLX models serve parallel generations via OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL, and a scheduler fix (#19581) targets a VRAM-leak path where ollama serve fails to reap an idle llama-server runner. The dominant theme, however, is Vulkan backend instability across AMD and Intel iGPUs on the 0.40.x llama-server-based builds, with three separate crash reports (AMD Renoir, Intel Lunar Lake, AMD Navi 14) all updated today.

2. Releases & Breaking Changes

None. No releases in the last 24 hours.

Context worth flagging for anyone pinning versions: multiple issues updated today attribute behavior changes to the 0.40.x transition to a llama-server-based runner — #19158 explicitly notes gemma4:12b "worked on 0.34.4" and broke on 0.40.x, and #19558 reports crashes on both 0.40.14 stable and 0.40.15-rc2. Treat 0.40.x as a migration boundary for GPU backend selection, not a routine bump.

  • Issue #19158 — regression introduced by 0.40.x
  • Issue #19558 — affected versions enumerated

3. New Model & Hardware Support

Item Status Notes
PR #19580 — windows: add CUDA 13.5 and SM 103 for ARM64 CLOSED/merged Adds CUDA 13.5 + SM 103 for Windows ARM64; retains SM 121 support; other platforms unchanged. Expands usable NVIDIA hardware on ARM64 Windows.
PR #18078 — MLX: make Qwen3.8 Flash Next memory efficient CLOSED Replaces blanket NVFP4 quantization with a mixed scheme: QSA projections and the non-expert MTP path kept in BF16, MXFP8 for other eligible dense/control weights. Published as qwen3.8-flash-next:125b-a6b-nvfp4 and ...:125b-mlx.
Issue #19566 — MLX support for dense Nemotron / Luciole Safetensors OPEN, feature request v0.40.15 rejects direct Safetensors→MLX conversions with unsupported architecture: NemotronForCausalLM. The MLX runner registers Nemotron-H but not dense Nemotron (affects Luciole-1B and 23B). Reporter offers to contribute the patch.

Hardware gaps surfaced today (all Vulkan): AMD Renoir gfx90c (#19558), Intel Arc 130V / Lunar Lake (#19158), AMD RX 5500 / Navi 14 gfx1010 (#19589 — --list-devices fails with SIGBUS).

4. Performance & Optimization

  • PR #19197 — mlx: support concurrent generation (OPEN, updated today). Lets MLX models serve multiple concurrent generations through OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL, cutting time-to-first-token under load. Ready requests share projection and feed-forward compute; attention is kept per-request. Default remains 1 request — parallelism costs memory per active request. This is the most significant perf change in flight.
  • PR #19585 — llm: handle split memory log lines (OPEN, fixes #19204). memoryParsingWriter.Write() parsed each write independently, so log lines split across writes failed regex matching, producing inaccurate memory and VRAM accounting. Buffers incomplete lines between writes. Directly affects scheduler load decisions.
  • PR #19581 — sched: keep a runner we couldn't stop in the loaded set (OPEN, fixes #19577). Correctness fix with a perf consequence: a leaked runner's VRAM was treated as free, so the next load under-predicted available memory, tilted toward CPU offload, and spawned a second llama-server. Fixes the accounting chain that degrades throughput after a failed unload.
  • PR #18078 (see above) — targeted quantization to avoid the long-generation quality degradation seen with blanket NVFP4.

5. Stability & Regressions

Ranked by severity:

  1. GPU falls off the bus (Xid 79) under grammar-constrained generation — Issue #17026 (OPEN). cuda_v13 backend, RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, Ollama 0.30.10: long format-constrained generations crash with CUDA error: unspecified launch failure escalating to Xid 79. Same requests are fine on cuda_v12. No fix PR visible. Highest severity — requires host/GPU reset.
  2. Vulkan crash at model load on AMD Renoir iGPU — Issue #19558 (OPEN, filed today). llama-server exits with 0xe06d7363 (unhandled C++ exception) on Ryzen 4700U / gfx90c, for every model including ~380 MB ones, on 0.40.14 stable and 0.40.15-rc2. Vulkan backend is effectively unusable on this class of hardware.
  3. Vulkan device lost on Intel Arc 130V since 0.40.x — Issue #19158 (OPEN). gemma4:12b dies with ggml_vulkan: device lost on Vulkan0 immediately after tensor upload; regression from 0.34.4 with any GPU offload.
  4. Idle runner never reaped → VRAM leak — Issue #19577 (OPEN, filed today). At keep_alive expiry, ollama serve ignores the failed Close, marks the model unloaded, drops the runner from the scheduler, and logs nothing. The runner keeps all its VRAM; the next load sees too little free memory. Fix PR exists: #19581.
  5. AMD RX 5500 (Navi 14) undetected; SIGBUS on Vulkan — Issue #19589 (OPEN). llama-server --list-devices fails with signal: bus error (exit 135) under GGML_BACKEND Vulkan. Report includes a proposed fix.
  6. Intermittent 500 on /api/chat after a long streamed reply — Issue #19293 (OPEN). llama-server apply-template error … write: broken pipe, raised 2–3 s after the previous reply completes; runner stays healthy and an immediate retry succeeds. Affects 0.40.8 and 0.40.11 on macOS.
  7. ornith:35b renderer/parser leaks raw special tokens and tool-call XML — Issue #16992 (OPEN). Unparsed tool-call XML and special tokens reach OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible clients. Related parser fixes in flight: #19574 (stray <channel|> close tags in Gemma4Parser), #19590 (whitespace after </think> in deepseek3), #17021 (nesting depth for qwen3-coder tool-call close tags), #19588 (tool_result blocks missing ToolName on /v1/messages).
  8. ollama pull TLS handshake timeout on post-quantum-hostile networks — Issue #19430 (OPEN). Networks that silently drop TLS 1.3 ClientHellos carrying X25519MLKEM768 cause net/http: TLS handshake timeout against registry.ollama.ai. Relevant for locked-down corporate/edge egress.
  9. OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL + multimodal → failed processing images — Issue #4165 (CLOSED today after 24 comments). Long-standing interaction between parallel slots and vision models (llava, moondream) is now resolved/closed. Verify against your pinned version before relying on parallel multimodal serving.

Non-technical: Issue #19591 reports a duplicate $20 Stripe renewal on a cancelled account. Out of scope for infrastructure, but worth escalating to billing/support rather than the issue tracker.

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • Do not assume Vulkan works on iGPUs. Three independent crash classes (AMD Renoir, Intel Arc, AMD Navi 14) are open against 0.40.x. If you ship to consumer laptops or home-lab boxes, gate on backend detection and provide a CPU fallback; the Renoir case fails even on ~380 MB models, so "small model" is not a mitigation.
  • Pin to a known-good version and backend, not just a version. cuda_v13 and cuda_v12 diverge on the same hardware under constrained decoding (#17026). If you use format/JSON-schema-constrained generation heavily, prefer cuda_v12 until #17026 is addressed.
  • Make /api/chat retries idempotent-safe. The post-reply 500 in #19293 is transient and retry-succeeds — a single retry with backoff is a cheap, effective mitigation. Don't surface it to users as a hard failure.
  • Treat tool-call parsing as untrusted output. #16992 plus the four parser PRs landing today show the renderer/parser layer still leaks raw control tokens and malformed tool-call XML into client-visible streams. Validate tool-call payloads before executing them, and don't assume OpenAI/Anthropic compatibility is byte-exact for structured output.
  • Memory accounting is currently unreliable — don't trust reported VRAM. The combination of #19577 (silent leaked runner) and #19585 (split log lines break memory parsing) means /api/ps and scheduler decisions can be wrong. If you run multi-model workloads or long keep_alive, monitor GPU memory out-of-band.
  • Parallelism is expanding beyond the llama.cpp backend. MLX models gain OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL support via #19197 (default still 1). Budget VRAM per concurrent request before raising it, and note that the multimodal + parallel path was only just closed (#4165) — retest rather than assume.
  • Watch CUDA 13.5 / SM 103 on Windows ARM64 (#19580) if you're targeting Snapdragon-class dev machines or ARM64 CI runners with discrete NVIDIA GPUs.

  • Two-GPU image/video generation — shipped in v0.1.916-beta (see caveat in §5 for multi-GPU text/diffusion models).
  • Unified-memory quant fit badges — request to make fit badges visible/accurate on unified-memory laptops (Apple Silicon class); open. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/13947
  • Transformer block swap (layer offload to RAM) — long-standing feature request closed this window. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/3997
  • Per-model extended parameters (YaRN context extension without a separate unsloth run launch) and download speed limiting — both closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/7589 · https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/15603

4. Performance & Optimization

Landed / in review:

  • Diffusion warm-start autotune caching — a compiled diffusion load with a warm compile cache re-benchmarked every multi-config Triton reduction on each Studio reopen. On SDXL / L4: ~40 kernels, ~9.5 s of a 22 s first render, repeated every time. PR reads back the workers' autotune results instead. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16981
  • Heap return after image load — glibc keeps freed chunks below the mmap threshold in arenas, so staging copies stayed counted as used host RAM after weights were pinned/uploaded. PR returns that heap to the OS. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16934
  • WebKit restyle cost — closing any dialog or menu on long chats took 5–7 s on macOS WebKit and WebKitGTK; opening the browser pane on Linux WebKit took >20 s. Root cause: WebKit restyles every element on certain document mutations. Closed; CI gate allowances tightened afterward. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16961 · https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16978
  • Reduce-motion theme switch — light/dark flip took ~2.5 s vs ~230 ms with Reduce motion off (Windows Desktop), because a transition was started on every element. Fix in review. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16977
  • Long-conversation UI lag regression (web + desktop) — closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16603

Open, with measurements:

  • RAG ingest is batch-of-1 across documents — _embed_all (core/rag/ingestion.py:166) is called per document; _EMBED_BATCH only batches chunks within a document. Measured ~99 ms/chunk on the batch-of-1 path vs 2.07 ms batched — a ~48× gap for corpora of small files (notes, docs, wikis). https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16715

5. Stability & Regressions

Critical — crashes / hard aborts

  1. DiffusionGemma multi-GPU: prompts over ~1792 tokens abort the visual server — GGML_ASSERT n_ubatch >= n_tokens. Reproduced on 2× CUDA (RTX 3060 12 GB sm 8.6 + RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB sm 8.9), Windows 11, Studio API mode. No fix PR yet; effectively caps multi-GPU diffusion prompt length. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16925
  2. Krea 2 Turbo fails to load on Windows — 0xc0000005 access violation in the Studio backend, reproducible via Images → select unsloth/Krea-2-Turbo. No fix PR yet. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16892
  3. Desktop crash on v0.1.915-beta (Win 11, RTX 4060 Ti) — closed this window. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16816

High — functional breakage

  1. web_search always returns "No results found." — the ddgs request lacks an Accept header (DuckDuckGo returns 202), and yandex is missing from the engine allow-list. Any agent relying on Studio's search tool is silently non-functional. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16664
  2. search_conversation tool disappeared — third occurrence. Recurring tool-registration regression; no fix PR. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16706
  3. Image generation falls back to CPU/RAM on Windows 11 + RTX 3060 while text generation correctly uses the GPU; not reproducible on an M1 Pro. No fix PR. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16803
  4. Beta update does not complete on Desktop. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16897

Medium — correctness

  1. CLI treats a truncated stream as success — if Studio's HTTP response ends after a text delta but before a finish reason or [DONE], unsloth inference exits 0 with a partial answer and unsloth chat stores it as assistant history. Closed; relevant to anyone parsing these streams. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16867
  2. S3 dataset filename collisions — distinct object keys mapped to one local filename, silently pairing transcripts with the wrong recording; manifest shards could overwrite each other. Fix PR closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16830
  3. S3 audio JSONL prep fails on U+2028/U+2029 inside transcripts — one bad row blocks training. Closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16721
  4. RAG indexing during embedding-model download fails every file with EmbeddingModelDownloadRequiredError; nothing queues. Closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16714
  5. gemma-4-thinking chat template strips reasoning — closed. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/16699

Low — UI / cosmetic (all closed): Glass setting not applied consistently (#16770), Glass theme blurs entire background (#16820), wallpaper hidden in active chats by CSS specificity (#16736), model-selection resets across multi-model conversations (#14506).

Flaky CI: Inline images (windows-latest) failed twice today on unrelated PRs, both Firefox-only, on the same Japanese-filename check; PR adds a bounded grace period and timeout diagnostics. https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/pull/16923

6. What This Means for Application Developers

  • Don't trust a stream that ends without a terminal marker. The CLI previously treated a truncated response as a successful reply and persisted it as history (#16867). If you proxy Studio's HTTP API, validate for finish_reason or [DONE] yourself — the same failure mode will surface in your own client code.
  • Search-backed agents are degraded right now. web_search returns empty results unconditionally on current builds (#16664), and search_conversation has vanished for the third time (#16706). Pin a known-good version or stub the tool rather than assuming tool-call availability at startup.
  • Multi-GPU diffusion has a hard prompt-length ceiling. The n_ubatch >= n_tokens abort above ~1792 tokens (#16925) means long-prompt image workflows should stay single-GPU or chunk prompts until fixed.
  • RAG ingest cost is dominated by per-document embedding calls, not chunk count (#16715). For many-small-files corpora, batching at the ingestion layer is the highest-leverage workaround (~48× measured gap).
  • State is moving server-side. Preferences previously in localStorage are being synced per account (#16912, #16958); idle-unloaded GGUFs now reload with their original launch settings instead of defaults (#16927). If you depend on deterministic reload behavior, that's a fix — but verify context/KV-cache settings survive idle unload on your build.
  • Claude Pro/Max plans become usable without an API key via a claude CLI-backed Agent connection through Anthropic's Agent SDK (#16963) — worth watching if you're consolidating agent backends behind Studio.
  • Audio fine-tuning is broadening with LFM3-Audio-2B train → chat → export (LoRA / merged 16-bit / GGUF) in one flow (#16973).
  • Pin transformers < 5.23 until the checkpointing rename is fully absorbed (#16667).
